_note: Missions from 03_Evervale_Gameplay_Events_and_Unlocks_UPDATED.docx (main progression bands in section 11, side quests in section 15) and 02_Evervale_Complete_Story_Bible_UPDATED.docx (the 25 numbered main missions in section 10). Only these 25 main missions (M01 to M25) and 6 side quests (S01 to S06) are kept. starting_location is a locations.json id where one exists; otherwise a snake_case place name from the document (underground_facility, forest_cabin); the florist shop is in the Town square, or null where the document gives no place. completion_conditions and objective_steps for M01 to M05 use the conditions listed in scripts/mission_tracker.gd; each step's until condition says when that objective is done. M06 shows an end-of-Act-I objective until Act II is built, so the HUD does not spell out its plot.
